subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: What direct-DM retention policy and Feishu sender-id validation or repair path should OpenClaw support for existing Feishu DM session keys?
rationale: The remaining fix affects durable session retention, Feishu identity validation, and possible history repair, so automation should not choose the product and migration boundary alone.

options.title: TTL-aware direct-DM protection with doctor repair
options.body: Protect active direct DM sessions under a bounded retention rule and add Feishu-specific validation or repair for malformed direct peer keys before changing persisted history.

options.title: Blanket-protect direct DM sessions
options.body: Treat all direct DM rows as durable conversation pointers, accepting larger stores in exchange for simpler session-continuity behavior.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Keep current maintenance behavior and rely on per-account-channel-peer plus operator cleanup, leaving malformed direct peer-id recovery outside the product for now.

recommendation.title: TTL-aware direct-DM protection with doctor repair
recommendation.body: Protect active direct DM sessions under a bounded retention rule and add Feishu-specific validation or repair for malformed direct peer keys before changing persisted history.

likelyOwner.reason: The key unresolved choice is session maintenance retention policy, and steipete has the strongest recent history in that code path.
